description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 09.02.2015 to 15.02.2015
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges under the Customs Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs valuation and compliance requirements, falling squarely within the Legal/Regulatory category (Type 5) for regulatory matters and statutory instruments. While it names an official (Director General of Customs), this is in the context of exercising regulatory authority rather than a personnel appointment or government restructuring.
